# Format and alignment-type compatibility

<!-- Generated by `msatk formats > docs/compatibility.md`; do not edit by hand. -->

MSATK distinguishes the **alignment type** (data model), the **method** that produced
it (global, local, ...; recorded as metadata when the format states it) and the
**file format**. Each format below is declared in a machine-readable registry
(`msatk.alignments.registry`), and this page is generated from it.

Support levels: **stable** (tested, publication scope), **beta** (implemented and
tested on fixtures), **experimental** (implemented, no test fixture yet), **planned**
(recognised by `msatk inspect` but not readable yet).
Gzip-compressed input (`.gz`) is accepted for every text format marked *gz*.

## Data models

| Kind | Model | Description | Valid analyses | Deliberately not computed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sequence` | SequenceAlignment | Rows of one rectangular alignment (pairwise or multiple). | alignment/site/sequence/pair statistics; QC findings; population genetics (nucleotides); codon usage, RSCU, frames, alternative genetic codes (codon); physicochemical and BLOSUM62 substitution scores (protein); pairwise-alignment statistics (exactly two sequences); RNA base-pair conservation and covariation (SS_cons); profile match/insert states (A2M/A3M, #=GC RF); per-partition statistics (charsets / partition file); alignment figures, logos, HTML report, ML encodings | – |
| `block` | BlockAlignment | Local alignment blocks with genomic coordinates (whole-genome). | block size distribution (N50); per-genome aligned fraction, coverage and duplication; strand and collinearity breakpoints relative to the reference; per-block gap, variability and consensus identity | concatenated MSA statistics (blocks are never merged); all-vs-all identity across genomes |
| `read` | ReadAlignment | Sequencing reads mapped to reference coordinates (SAM/BAM/CRAM). | mapping rate and flag summary; MAPQ distribution; CIGAR: clipping, indels, splicing, mismatch rate; base quality, read length, insert size; per-reference depth and breadth of coverage | all-vs-all read identity; column entropy over a read pileup |
| `mapping` | MappingAlignment | Pairwise local hits/mappings (PAF, PSL, BLAST tabular, GAF). | hit counts and multi-hit queries; identity (format-specific definition) and alignment length; MAPQ, e-value; query and target coverage | column-wise MSA statistics |
| `graph` | GraphAlignment | Sequence/variation graphs and pangenome paths (GFA 1, rGFA). | segment, link and component statistics; tips and branching; path/walk lengths; core / shell / private segments across paths | flattening into a rectangular alignment |
| `profile_model` | ProfileModel | Profile HMMs (HMMER3, HH-suite HHM). | model metadata; match-state emission entropy (HMMER3) | sequence-level statistics (no sequences in the file) |
| `structure` | StructureAlignment (planned) | 3D coordinates and structural superpositions (PDB, mmCIF). | – | all analyses until structural alignment support is implemented |

## Formats

| Format | Family | Extensions | Kind | Level | Reader | gz | Preserved annotations | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FASTA (aligned) | Standard MSA | .fa, .fasta, .fas, .faa, .fna, .afa, .mfa | `sequence` | stable | native | gz | ids, descriptions | – |
| PHYLIP (strict and relaxed, sequential) | Standard MSA | .phy, .phylip | `sequence` | stable | native | gz | ids | – |
| CLUSTAL | Standard MSA | .aln, .clustal, .clw | `sequence` | stable | native | gz | ids | – |
| NEXUS | Standard MSA / multi-locus | .nex, .nexus, .nxs | `sequence` | stable | native | gz | ids, charset partitions | – |
| Stockholm | Standard MSA / RNA structure | .sto, .stk, .stockholm | `sequence` | stable | native | gz | ids, #=GC SS_cons, #=GC RF, other #=GC tracks | – |
| A3M (HH-suite) | Specialized MSA / profile | .a3m | `sequence` | beta | native | gz | match states, insert lengths | Lowercase = insertions (removed from the matrix, counted); insert gaps omitted. |
| A2M | Specialized MSA / profile | .a2m | `sequence` | beta | native | gz | match states, insert lengths | Lowercase = insertions, '.' = insert gaps. |
| MSF / GCG | Specialized MSA | .msf | `sequence` | beta | native | gz | ids | '.' and '~' are read as gaps. |
| MEGA | Specialized MSA | .meg, .mega | `sequence` | beta | native | gz | ids | '.' (identical to first sequence) is expanded. |
| SELEX | Specialized MSA | .slx, .selex | `sequence` | beta | native | gz | ids | – |
| MASE | Specialized MSA | .mase | `sequence` | beta | native | gz | ids | – |
| EMBOSS pairwise (needle, water, stretcher, matcher) | Pairwise alignment | .needle, .water, .emboss | `sequence` | beta | native | gz | method (global/local), reported score, scoring parameters | – |
| PAF | Pairwise alignment / mapping | .paf | `mapping` | beta | native | gz | coordinates, strand, MAPQ | – |
| PSL (BLAT) | Pairwise alignment / mapping | .psl | `mapping` | beta | native | gz | coordinates, strand, block counts | – |
| BLAST/DIAMOND tabular (-outfmt 6) | Pairwise alignment / hits | .blast6, .outfmt6, .m8 | `mapping` | beta | native | gz | coordinates, e-value, bit score | – |
| BLAST XML / JSON | Pairwise alignment / hits | .xml, .json | `mapping` | planned | none | – | – | Use -outfmt 6 for now. |
| SAM | Sequencing reads | .sam | `read` | beta | native | gz | reference coordinates, CIGAR, flags, MAPQ, NM, qualities | – |
| BAM | Sequencing reads | .bam | `read` | beta | pysam | – | reference coordinates, CIGAR, flags, MAPQ, NM, qualities | – |
| CRAM | Sequencing reads | .cram | `read` | experimental | pysam | – | reference coordinates, CIGAR, flags, MAPQ, NM, qualities | Pass the reference FASTA when the CRAM needs it. |
| MAF (multiple alignment format) | Whole-genome alignment | .maf | `block` | beta | native | gz | block membership, coordinates, strand, source sizes, scores | – |
| XMFA (Mauve) | Whole-genome alignment | .xmfa | `block` | beta | native | gz | block membership, coordinates, strand | – |
| AXT | Whole-genome alignment | .axt | `block` | beta | native | gz | coordinates, strand, scores | – |
| UCSC chain | Whole-genome alignment | .chain | `block` | planned | none | gz | – | No sequences; needs a block-size model. |
| HAL (Cactus) | Whole-genome alignment | .hal | `block` | planned | none | – | – | Export to MAF with hal2maf. |
| HMMER3 profile HMM | Profile alignment | .hmm | `profile_model` | beta | native | gz | model metadata, match emissions, COMPO | – |
| HH-suite HHM | Profile alignment | .hhm | `profile_model` | beta | native | gz | model metadata | Metadata only. |
| GFA 1 / rGFA | Pangenome graph | .gfa, .gfa1, .rgfa | `graph` | beta | native | gz | segments, links, paths, walks, rGFA rank | GFA 2 not yet supported. |
| GAF (graph alignment) | Pangenome graph | .gaf | `mapping` | beta | native | gz | graph paths, coordinates, MAPQ | – |
| GBZ | Pangenome graph | .gbz | `graph` | planned | none | – | – | Convert with `vg view` / `gbz2gfa`. |
| ODGI | Pangenome graph | .og | `graph` | planned | none | – | – | Convert with `odgi view -g`. |
| PDB | Protein structure | .pdb, .ent | `structure` | planned | none | gz | – | Coordinates are not a residue alignment. |
| mmCIF | Protein structure | .cif, .mmcif | `structure` | planned | none | gz | – | Coordinates are not a residue alignment. |

Related inputs that are **not** alignments — unaligned FASTA/FASTQ, VCF, BED, GFF/GTF —
are reads, sequences, variants or annotations and are not treated as completed
alignments.
